title: 第1162章 盘皇还是古帝第1161章 生死轮回饿死诡死
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
饿死诡留下的残魂彻底消失在阳间，但却在阴间复活。
而饱死诡，则是将饿死诡的所有阴气吸收，从一个瘦子吃成了大胖子，比饿死诡还胖。
这是阴气太过庞大，饱死诡短暂时间内消化不了导致的。
可以这么说，饿死诡一只诡的阴气，比起十七只诡加起来的总和还要多。
饱死诡消化期间，惊惧的看着一对肉掌，语气喜悦中带着震惊道：
“这，这感觉……太强大了！”
“原来饿死诡竟然是如此的强大，我一直以为我们只是差了一星半点，结果却是天差地别。”
“那么和饿死诡齐平的赵寒，该有多么强大？”
“怪不得我不是他对手！”
见到饱死诡这般模样，殷盘语气淡淡道：
“饱死诡，你要记住是谁给你的今日！”
饱死诡一听，立刻从实力暴涨的喜悦当中回过神来。
同时它也感受到自己这具肉身体内，似乎被种下了什么东西。
看向殷盘，饱死诡知晓殷盘在刚才将饿死诡的阴气传输给它时，在它的肉身上动了手脚。
但实力暴涨，还是让它将这些小问题撇之脑后，继续磕头语气卑微道：
“我饱死诡，一生一世侍奉陛下！”
“陛下让我上刀山下火海，我饱死诡眉头也不会皱一下。”
殷盘笑了笑道，然后语气平淡道：
“好，不过，现在殷辛和朕几乎明牌，他早就从饿死诡那里得知了朕的谋划和一部分底牌。”
“此地不宜久留，你吞服这具大帝肉身后，赶紧回到归府，免得被他察觉。”

“而朕要离开此地，有其他事要做。”
“你就按照以往来做事即可，我要找你的时候，你自然会听到。”
“至于暴露，你不必在意，朕做任何事，都不会被天机测算到。”
“呵呵，殷辛怕是还不知道，朕这十万年来的经营，远不止九幽和帝陵那么简单！”
殷盘嘴角上钩。
十万年的时间，足以让他做好充足准备，建立起隐藏在暗地里的恐怖势力。
生死轮回大道虽然因为饿死诡而错过了时机，未能领悟，但殷盘还有其他准备和谋划。
这些准备，同样不是殷辛可以抗衡的，至少在他眼里是这样认为。
而他的其他谋划，也不比领悟生死轮回大道差。
只是领悟生死轮回大道是一条捷径，但同时领悟的概率要小很多。
所以殷盘还是准备了第二条甚至第三条路。
至少目前，殷盘并未因为被殷辛和饿死诡破坏了悟道计划，心态受到太大冲击。
只是愤怒饿死诡背叛而已。
见到殷盘欲要离开，饱死诡犹豫了一下，还是将心中疑惑问了出来：
“陛，陛下，我想问您，您现在究竟是……盘皇，还是古帝？”
盘皇，是殷辛父皇殷盘，也就是上一任大殷的皇帝的帝号。
皇帝皇帝，帝号可称皇，也可称帝。
稍微谦虚一点的，比如殷盘，就会自称皇。
殷辛的帝号，便是自称帝辛。
而古帝，则是饱死诡对殷玄古帝的称谓。

“你说呢！”殷盘面无表情的瞥了眼饱死诡。
content_en:
The remaining souls left by the starved to death completely disappeared into the world of the world, but were resurrected in the underworld.
As for the Full Death Cui, he absorbed all the yin energy of the Starving Death Cui and ate it from a thin man to a fat man, even fatter than the Starvation Cui.
This was caused by the Yin Qi being too large and unable to be digested by the Shitui in a short period of time.
It can be said that the Yin Qi that starves one Jui to death is more than the sum total of seventeen Jui.
During the process of digestion, Shigui looked at a pair of fleshy palms in horror, and said with joy and shock in his tone:
"This, this feeling... is so powerful!"
"It turns out that the starving to death trick is so powerful. I always thought that we were just a little bit behind, but the result is a world of difference."
"So how powerful must Zhao Han be, who is on par with the Starving Gui?"
"No wonder I'm not his match!"
Seeing Shou Shigui's appearance, Yin Pan said calmly:
"Fu Shigui, you have to remember who gave you this day!"
After hearing this, Su Shigui immediately came back to his senses from the joy of the surge in strength.
At the same time, it also felt that something seemed to be planted in its physical body.
Looking at Yin Pan, the Full Death Quiet knew that Yin Pan had moved his hands and feet on its body when he had just transferred the Yin Qi of the Starved Death Quilt to it.
However, due to the sudden increase in strength, he still put these small problems aside and continued to kowtow and said in a humble tone:
"I am so full of tricks that I will serve your Majesty all my life!"
"Your Majesty asked me to go up mountains of swords and seas of fire, and I would be so full that I would not even frown."
Yin Pan smiled and then said in a calm tone:
"Okay, but now Yin Xin and I are almost in the clear. He has already learned about my plan and some of my trump cards from Starving Death."
"It's not advisable to stay here for a long time. After you swallow this great emperor's body, hurry back to Guifu to avoid being noticed by him."
"And I have to leave this place and have other things to do."
"Just do what you have done in the past. When I want to find you, you will naturally hear me."
"As for exposure, you don't have to worry about it. Whatever I do will not be measured by heaven."
"Haha, I'm afraid Yin Xin doesn't know that my management over the past 100,000 years is far more than just Jiuyou and the Imperial Tomb!"
Yin Pan curled his lips.
One hundred thousand years is enough time for him to be fully prepared and establish a terrifying force hidden in the dark.
Although he missed the opportunity and failed to understand the road of reincarnation due to starvation, Yin Pan had other preparations and plans.
These preparations are also not something Yin Xin can compete with, at least in his eyes.
And his other plans are no worse than understanding the reincarnation of life and death.
It's just a shortcut to comprehend the great road of reincarnation, but the probability of comprehending it at the same time is much smaller.
So Yin Pan still prepared a second or even a third way.
At least for now, Yin Pan's mentality has not been greatly affected because Yin Xin and Starvation Gui ruined his enlightenment plan.
It's just anger, starvation and betrayal.
Seeing Yin Pan about to leave, Bao Shigui hesitated for a moment, then asked the doubts in his heart:
"Your Majesty, Your Majesty, I want to ask you, are you... Panhuang or Ancient Emperor?"
Panhuang is the imperial title of Yin Xin's father, Emperor Yin Pan, who was the previous emperor of Yin.
Emperor, emperor, the title can be called emperor or emperor.
Those who are a little more modest, such as Yin Pan, will call themselves emperors.
Yin Xin's imperial title is to call himself Emperor Xin.
As for the Ancient Emperor, it was the title given to the Ancient Emperor Yin Xuan by the full dead guerrilla.
"What do you think?" Yin Pan glanced at Bao Shigui expressionlessly.
